newsitem.title: LEBANON: Belgian airline resumes flights to Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Belgian airline resumes flights to Beirut.

text.p: Belgian Sabena Airlines resumed flights to Beirut on Sunday after a 12-year stoppage due to Lebanon's 1975-1990 civil war.
More than 70 passengers arrived on a Boeing 737 which will fly three times a week from Brussels to Beirut, Beirut Airport officials said.
This brought to 30 the number of Arab and international airlines operating to and from Beirut in addition to Lebanon's national Middle East Airlines and cargo carrier Trans Mediterranean Airlines.
